description: This file manages plugin installation, removal, and cluster synchronization for Mattermost, including handling plugin bundles, signatures, and cluster messaging.

classes.name: Channels
classes.description: Struct managing plugin lifecycle and cluster communication.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct handling plugin installation.

methods.name: installPluginFromClusterMessage
methods.description: Handles plugin installation triggered by cluster message, including signature verification and notification.

methods.name: removePluginFromClusterMessage
methods.description: Handles plugin removal triggered by cluster message, including local removal and notification.

methods.name: InstallPlugin
methods.description: Installs a plugin from a provided file, with optional replacement.

methods.name: installPlugin
methods.description: Core method to extract, verify, and install plugin bundle, then update cluster.

methods.name: installPluginToFilestore
methods.description: Stores plugin bundle and signature to filestore and notifies cluster.

methods.name: InstallMarketplacePlugin
methods.description: Installs a plugin from marketplace, preferring prepackaged or remote source.

methods.name: installPluginLocally
methods.description: Extracts and installs plugin bundle locally, handling upgrade logic.

methods.name: extractPlugin
methods.description: Unpacks plugin tarball into directory and finds manifest.

methods.name: installExtractedPlugin
methods.description: Moves extracted plugin to final location, activates if needed, and handles upgrades.

methods.name: RemovePlugin
methods.description: Removes plugin from all servers and filesystem.

methods.name: removePluginLocally
methods.description: Deactivates and deletes plugin from current server.

methods.name: removeSignature
methods.description: Removes plugin signature file from storage.
